title.en: AN ACT CHANGING THE NAME OF THE PUEBLO OF PATOC, IN THE PROVINCE OF ABRA, TO THAT OF PEÑARRUBIA.
title.orig: AN ACT CHANGING THE NAME OF THE PUEBLO OF PATOC, IN THE PROVINCE OF ABRA, TO THAT OF PEÑARRUBIA.
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên pueblo Patoc thuộc tỉnh Abra thành Peñarrubia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อปูเอโบร์ปาโต๊กในจังหวัดอับราเป็นเปญาร์รูเบีย
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama pueblo Patoc di Provinsi Abra menjadi Peñarrubia
title.ms: Akta menukar nama pueblo Patoc di Wilayah Abra kepada Peñarrubia

text.en:
Upon the application of the municipal council for the pueblo of Patoc, in the Province of Abra, the
name of such pueblo is changed from Patoc to Peñarrubia.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, March 4, 1903.
